title: Cartesian geometric atlas for glued universal thickenings
statement: Let $h : Z \to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $C$ be an open cover of $Z$ indexed in the schemes universe, and for each index $k$ let $i_k : C_k \to Z_k^{\prime}$ and $h_k^{\prime} : Z_k^{\prime} \to X$ be a universal first order thickening of $C_k$ over $X$ for $C.f_k \circ h$ [def-weil-pbc-universal-first-order-thickening]. There exist a scheme $W$, morphisms $j : Z \to W$ and $p : W \to X$, and open immersions $e_k : Z_k^{\prime} \to W$ [def-weil-open-immersion], whose images cover $W$, such that $p \circ j=h$, $p \circ e_k=h_k^{\prime}$, and for each $k$ the square with top arrow $i_k$, left arrow $C.f_k$, right arrow $e_k$ and bottom arrow $j$ is cartesian (that is, $C_k$, with these two projections, is the categorical pullback of $e_k$ and $j$). No property of the global kernel ideal or global universal lifting property is asserted.

source.place: Tag 04F3 (lemma-universal-thickening), proof, fourth and fifth paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04F3

proof.text: Use the compatible-chart construction to obtain W and a jointly surjective family of open immersions e_k, compatibility of h prime and i_k followed by e_k on their respective pullbacks, and the pointwise chart-overlap equivalence.

Make the e_k into an open cover D of W. Glue the compatible h prime maps over D to p and the compatible i_k followed by e_k over C to j using Scheme.Cover.glueMorphisms. Its restriction formula proves e_k followed by p equals h prime_k and C.f_k followed by j equals i_k followed by e_k. Apply C.hom_ext and the local universal-thickening commuting equations to show j followed by p equals h.

For each k apply Mathlib IsOpenImmersion.isPullback to C.f_k and e_k. The commuting equation is the restriction formula for j. Test equality of the inverse-image open of e_k with the range of C.f_k at a point of Z; write it as C.f_l(z) using C.exists_eq, replace j(C.f_l(z)) by e_l(i_l(z)), and apply the core construction overlap equivalence. This establishes the categorical pullback, including its structure sheaf.

Second reading: IsOpenImmersion.isPullback proves the final cartesian-square step from commutativity and equality of opens; isPullback_lift_id, image_preimage_eq_preimage_image_of_isPullback and ker_ideal_of_isPullback_of_isOpenImmersion do not construct a glued atlas.

Second reading: UniversalFirstOrderThickeningCoverGluing applies the assigned theorem, so using it would create a cycle. Other gluing results concern effective models, and upstream dual-number constructions do not give the supplied universal thickening atlas.

lean.statement:
theorem universalFirstOrderThickening_cartesianAtlas
    {Z X : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (C : Z.OpenCover.{u})
    (Z' : C.I₀ → Scheme.{u}) (i : ∀ k, C.X k ⟶ Z' k)
    (h' : ∀ k, Z' k ⟶ X)
    (H : ∀ k, IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening (C.f k ≫ h) (i k) (h' k)) :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : Z ⟶ W) (p : W ⟶ X) (e : ∀ k, Z' k ⟶ W),
      (∀ k, IsOpenImmersion (e k)) ∧ (∀ w : W, ∃ k z, e k z = w) ∧
      j ≫ p = h ∧ (∀ k, e k ≫ p = h' k) ∧
      ∀ k, IsPullback (i k) (C.f k) (e k) j
